venue.name: Sweet Pea Quilting
venue.description: Sweet Pea Quilting is a quilt shop in Parksville selling fabric, kits, patterns and quilting supplies, with a longarm quilting service that takes quilts in for finishing. It runs one day quilting classes in an onsite classroom, taught by experienced instructors, priced from $30 for a sew day up to $375 for a twelve month block of the month programme, and these are aimed at quilters working on their own projects. Nothing on the site is offered to schools, daycares or groups of children, and there is no children's class, holiday camp, tour or group visit. It is a shop with a classroom attached.
